history: Ubiquitous from the 2000s onward, and the reason most bars keep energy drink behind the bar at all.
whyItWorks: Nothing is balanced here. It is caffeine and vodka, and it is ordered for what it does rather than how it tastes.
steps: Pour chilled vodka into a shot glass.
Top with energy drink and drink immediately.
name: Vodka and Energy Drink Shot
description: The highball in one glass, for people in a hurry.
